netty--netty--6096.title: Netty should stop swallowing
netty--netty--6096.reason: Broad Throwable propagation discussion. A recent reactor-netty report describes a stranded Mono, but provides no pinned, independent reproducer. Keep as an unverified lifecycle-provenance lead rather than a selected CoroPerf result.
netty--netty--6096.reason_zh: 这是 Throwable 传播语义的长期讨论。近期 reactor-netty 评论描述 Mono 悬空，但没有固定版本的独立复现；保留为尚未验证的生命周期来源线索，不列为 CoroPerf 成功案例。
netty--netty--6096.native_diagnostic_assessment: Existing errors identify allocation/decoder/event-loop paths; they do not identify the affected business subscription or request.
netty--netty--6096.native_diagnostic_assessment_zh: 已有错误栈给出分配、decoder 与 event-loop 路径，但没有标识受影响的业务订阅或请求。
netty--netty--6096.coroperf_gap_assessment: Would require exact Throwable-to-Channel/Promise/Mono identity plus historical task or subscription registration origin. A sampled Java Thread stack alone cannot supply these joins; CoroPerf support and benefit remain unverified.
netty--netty--6096.coroperf_gap_assessment_zh: 需要精确 Throwable→Channel/Promise/Mono 身份及任务或订阅登记历史；仅采样 Java Thread 栈无法补齐，CoroPerf 的采集支持与收益均未验证。
netty--netty--6096.reproduction_prerequisites: A pinned affected Netty/reactor-netty version, a bounded controlled managed-error fixture, observable terminal state and exact request/Promise identity. No independent quick fixture is supplied; real memory exhaustion is unnecessary and was not attempted.
netty--netty--6096.reproduction_prerequisites_zh: 需固定受影响版本、受控且有界的 managed-error fixture、可观测终止状态及精确请求/Promise 身份。来源未给独立快速程序；没有尝试真实内存耗尽。
netty--netty--6096.security_or_native_fault_classification: No explicit exploit or native memory-fault signal established. Managed Error propagation alone is not a confirmed safety finding.

netty--netty--11020.title: Unable to load io.netty.resolver.dns.macos.MacOSDnsServerAddressStreamProvider
netty--netty--11020.reason: The platform-provider load cause is explicit. Despite a stackless DNS timeout leaf, the outer failure already includes the HTTP request and Spring Gateway checkpoints; no missing business entry point is established.
netty--netty--11020.reason_zh: 平台 provider 装载原因已明确。尽管 DNS timeout 末端无栈，外层异常已包含 HTTP 请求和 Spring Gateway checkpoint；尚未发现缺失的业务入口。
netty--netty--11020.native_diagnostic_assessment: The chain reports UnsatisfiedLinkError, then a request ID, HTTP route and assembly checkpoints around DNS failure.
netty--netty--11020.native_diagnostic_assessment_zh: 异常链给出 UnsatisfiedLinkError，以及 DNS 失败对应的请求 ID、HTTP 路由与 assembly checkpoint。
netty--netty--11020.coroperf_gap_assessment: An exact provider/resolver-to-request identity relation is not captured, but the current report does not need it to recover its entry point. Another caller graph would not establish a DNS or packaging cause beyond the supplied diagnostics.
netty--netty--11020.coroperf_gap_assessment_zh: 未采集精确 provider/resolver→请求身份关系，但现有报告恢复入口并不依赖它；额外调用图尚无超出已有 DNS/依赖诊断的已证实收益。
netty--netty--11020.reproduction_prerequisites: Reported macOS x86_64/OpenJ9 Java 15, Netty 4.1.58, reactor-netty 1.0.3 and three Spring Cloud/Eureka modules; architecture/classifier and resolver environment matter. This is not a self-contained Linux first check.
netty--netty--11020.reproduction_prerequisites_zh: 原始前提为 macOS x86_64/OpenJ9 Java 15、Netty 4.1.58、reactor-netty 1.0.3 及三模块 Spring Cloud/Eureka；架构、classifier 和 resolver 环境均关键，不是当前 Linux 上的独立快速首检。
netty--netty--11020.security_or_native_fault_classification: A managed native-library linkage failure; no explicit native crash, memory corruption or exploit signal established. This diagnostic exclusion is not a security hold.

tokio-rs--tokio--5835.reason: The reporter retracted the initial report: an empty JoinSet::join_next returns Ready(None) and does not retain a waker. Later comments discuss wake-on-push expectations in a custom outer Future, not a demonstrated lost historical task origin. No program, build or capture ran.
tokio-rs--tokio--5835.reason_zh: 报告者已撤回最初结论：空 JoinSet::join_next 返回 Ready(None)，不会保存 waker。后续评论讨论自定义外层 Future 的 push 唤醒预期，尚未建立历史任务来源缺失；未执行程序、构建或采集。

chriskohlhoff--asio--1156.reason: The supplied native C++ program explicitly reports a failing strand assertion after nested cancellation. Keep as a reported native-failure hold; impact is unassessed. Source review only, no dependency setup, build, workload, capture or fix test.
chriskohlhoff--asio--1156.reason_zh: 所附原生 C++ 程序明确报告嵌套取消后的 strand 断言失败，按原生故障线索暂缓，影响未评估。仅来源审阅，没有准备依赖、构建、运行、采集或修复测试。

scope: Two high-heat Netty reviews, one retracted Tokio report, and one metadata-only native-failure hold. User-skipped Tokio #8772 remains stopped.
